<!DOCTYPE html>

<html data-theme="dark" lang="tr">

<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="#0e1411" name="theme-color"/>
<meta content="Sertaç Türe'nin kişisel sitesi: Valorant, Lumos yayınları, oyun klipleri, bisiklet ve uzun yürüyüşler." name="description"/>
<meta content="Sertaç Türe — Valorant, Doğa &amp; Yayın" property="og:title"/>
<meta content="Muhasebe alanında çalışıyorum. İş dışında oyun, teknoloji, bisiklet ve yayınla ilgileniyorum." property="og:description"/>
<meta content="website" property="og:type"/>
<meta content="https://sertacture.com/og_sertacture.jpg" property="og:image"/>
<meta content="1200" property="og:image:width"/>
<meta content="630" property="og:image:height"/>
<meta content="Sertaç Türe — muhasebe, oyun, bisiklet ve yayın" property="og:image:alt"/>
<meta content="summary_large_image" name="twitter:card"/>
<meta content="https://sertacture.com/og_sertacture.jpg" name="twitter:image"/>
<title>Sertaç Türe — Valorant, Doğa &amp; Yayın</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&amp;family=Playfair+Display:wght@500;600;700&amp;family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
    :root{
      --bg:#f7f2ea;
      --bg-soft:#fbf8f2;
      --panel:#ffffff;
      --panel-soft:#f1eadf;
      --ink:#101613;
      --muted:#6d766f;
      --line:rgba(16,22,19,.10);
      --forest:#16211b;
      --forest-2:#1f3028;
      --forest-3:#2f4337;
      --accent:#d9915c;
      --accent-2:#f0b47e;
      --sage:#bfd0c0;
      --purple:#6659d8;
      --gold:#caa15e;
      --shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(16,22,19,.10);
      --radius:28px;
      --max:1180px;
    }
    html[data-theme="dark"]{
      --bg:#0e1411;
      --bg-soft:#121915;
      --panel:#151d18;
      --panel-soft:#1b261f;
      --ink:#f3ede4;
      --muted:#a0aba1;
      --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      --forest:#18231d;
      --forest-2:#223228;
      --forest-3:#314438;
      --shadow:0 34px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
    }

    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{
      font-family:'Manrope',system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
      color:var(--ink);
      background:var(--bg);
      line-height:1.7;
      overflow-x:hidden;
      transition:background .3s ease,color .3s ease;
    }
    body::before{
      content:"";
      position:fixed;
      inset:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      opacity:.22;
      z-index:999;
      background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 160 160' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.035'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }
    a{color:inherit}
    img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
    button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
    .container{width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 44px));margin:auto}
    .section{padding:76px 0;position:relative}
    .eyebrow{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
      font:600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
      text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--accent);
    }
    .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:26px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.8}
    .section-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:42px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:34px}
    .section-head h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,62px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:600;margin-top:12px}
    .section-head p{justify-self:end;max-width:560px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
    .panel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
    .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
    .reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
    .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:50px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:14px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;transition:.25s ease;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}
    .btn-primary{background:var(--accent);color:#1b120d}
    .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
    .btn-secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line)}
    .btn-secondary:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);transform:translateY(-2px)}

    /* nav */
    .nav-wrap{position:fixed;top:16px;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;pointer-events:none}
    nav{
      pointer-events:auto;
      width:min(1080px,calc(100% - 30px));
      margin:auto;
      padding:10px 12px 10px 18px;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;
      border-radius:18px;
      border:1px solid var(--line);
      background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
      backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(145%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(145%);
      box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
    }
    .logo{text-decoration:none;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap}
    .nav-links{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
    .nav-links a,.nav-icon{
      text-decoration:none;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;
      color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;transition:.25s ease;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover,.nav-icon:hover{color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
    .nav-side{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
    .nav-cta{background:var(--accent);color:#20150f;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:12px;transition:.25s ease}
    .nav-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:var(--accent-2)}

    /* hero */
    header{
      position:relative;min-height:92svh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;
      color:#fff;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 84% 20%, rgba(217,145,92,.22), transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%, rgba(191,208,192,.10), transparent 24%),
        linear-gradient(140deg,#0c120f 0%,#17231d 55%,#223127 100%);
      isolation:isolate;
    }
    header::before{
      content:"";position:absolute;right:-220px;top:-170px;width:620px;height:620px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      box-shadow:0 0 0 90px rgba(255,255,255,.018),0 0 0 180px rgba(255,255,255,.012);z-index:-1;
    }
    .hero{width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 44px));margin:auto;padding:134px 0 68px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.03fr .97fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
    .hero h1{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(58px,7.6vw,96px);line-height:.93;letter-spacing:-.05em;font-weight:600;margin:16px 0 22px}
    .hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent-2)}
    .hero-lead{max-width:620px;font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,22px);line-height:1.55;color:rgba(255,255,255,.74)}
    .type-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);font:600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.13em;color:var(--accent-2)}
    .type-pill strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
    .hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px}
    .hero-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:34px}
    .meta-item{padding:15px 15px 14px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
    .meta-item small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:7px}
    .meta-item strong{display:block;font-size:15px;color:#fff}
    .meta-item span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);margin-top:3px}

    .hero-panel{position:relative}
    .hero-card{border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);box-shadow:0 40px 110px rgba(0,0,0,.34);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
    .hero-visual{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1.05/1;background:#121a16;padding:18px;display:grid;grid-template-rows:1fr auto;gap:14px}
    .hero-stage{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1b2720 0%,#101713 48%,#25372c 100%)}
    .hero-stage svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
    .hero-overlay{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
    .mini-card{padding:16px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    .mini-card small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:8px}
    .mini-card p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68)}
    .floating-tag{position:absolute;top:34px;right:-18px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:13px;color:#fff;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;background:#101713;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.28);transform:rotate(4deg)}

    /* about */
    .about{background:var(--bg)}
    .about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:16px}
    .about-main{padding:32px 34px}
    .about-main p{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.025em;max-width:760px}
    .about-side{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}
    .about-chip{padding:20px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--panel-soft);border:1px solid var(--line);min-height:118px}
    .about-chip small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px}
    .about-chip strong{display:block;font-size:17px;line-height:1.25}
    .about-chip p{margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}

    /* life + games */
    .life{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;padding-bottom:72px}
    .life .section-head p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.60)}
    .life-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
    .feature-card{position:relative;min-height:330px;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);background:#243128}
    .feature-card svg,.feature-card img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
    .feature-card:hover svg,.feature-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.035)}
    .feature-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 34%,rgba(8,12,10,.90) 100%)}
    .feature-copy{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:24px;right:24px;bottom:22px}
    .feature-copy small{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2)}
    .feature-copy h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:28px;line-height:1.08;margin:8px 0 6px}
    .feature-copy p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);max-width:430px}

    .games-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;margin:34px 0 18px;padding-top:30px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
    .games-head h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,3.1vw,42px);line-height:1.06;margin-top:10px}
    .games-head p{max-width:460px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.58);font-size:14px}
    .games-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:12px}
    .game-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);background:#1e2621;min-height:230px}
    .game-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 28%,rgba(7,10,9,.92) 100%)}
    .game-visual{position:absolute;inset:0}
    .game-visual svg{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .55s ease}
    .game-card:hover .game-visual svg{transform:scale(1.035)}
    .game-copy{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:16px}
    .game-copy small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:8px}
    .game-copy h4{font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:4px}
    .game-copy p{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68)}
    .valorant-main{grid-column:span 12;min-height:350px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#151b24 0%,#111318 42%,#181610 100%)}
    .subgame{grid-column:span 4}
    .value-pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
    .value-pills span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff}


    .hero-photo-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;height:100%}
    .hero-shot{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);min-height:420px;background:#141414}
    .hero-shot img,.game-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
    .hero-shot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,10,9,.08) 10%,rgba(7,10,9,.78) 100%)}
    .hero-shot-copy{position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:16px;z-index:2}
    .hero-shot-copy small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:7px}
    .hero-shot-copy strong{display:block;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;color:#fff}
    .game-photo{position:absolute;inset:0}
    .game-photo::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,10,9,.08) 18%,rgba(7,10,9,.92) 100%)}
    .valorant-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;height:100%}
    .valorant-half{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .valorant-half img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
    .valorant-half::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,10,9,.06) 12%,rgba(7,10,9,.88) 100%)}
    .valorant-half + .valorant-half{border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}




    /* clips */
    .clips-wrap{margin-top:38px;padding-top:32px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
    .clips-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;margin-bottom:18px}
    .clips-head h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,3.1vw,42px);line-height:1.06;margin-top:10px}
    .clips-head p{max-width:460px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.58);font-size:14px}
    .clips-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px}
    .clip-card{overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);background:#111713;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
    .clip-media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#070a08;overflow:hidden}
    .clip-media video{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:#070a08}
    .clip-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:16px 18px 17px}
    .clip-meta div{min-width:0}
    .clip-meta small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:8px}
    .clip-meta strong{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:15px;line-height:1.25}
    .clip-meta > span{flex:none;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.52)}
    @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
      .clip-card{transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease}
      .clip-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(240,180,126,.24);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
    }

    /* live */
    .live{background:var(--bg-soft)}
    .live-card{padding:38px 42px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .live-info h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 10px}
    .live-info p{color:var(--muted);max-width:520px;font-size:15px}
    .live-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:100px;padding:7px 15px;color:var(--muted)}
    .live-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);flex:none}
    .live-badge.is-live{border-color:rgba(240,90,90,.55);color:#F2B0A6}
    .live-badge.is-live .live-dot{background:#F05A5A;animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(240,90,90,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(240,90,90,0)}}

    /* contact */
    .contact{padding-top:0;background:var(--bg-soft)}
    .contact-shell{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:34px;min-height:260px;padding:40px 44px;border-radius:28px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111914,#223128);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(17,25,20,.18)}
    .contact-shell::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:380px;height:380px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);right:-120px;top:-150px;box-shadow:0 0 0 70px rgba(255,255,255,.018),0 0 0 140px rgba(255,255,255,.012)}
    .contact-copy{position:relative;z-index:1}
    .contact-copy h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(38px,4.2vw,58px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:12px 0 12px}
    .contact-copy p{max-width:600px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.60);font-size:14px}
    .identity-row{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
    .identity{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);padding:9px 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);font-size:12px;transition:.25s ease}
    .identity:hover{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(217,144,90,.50);transform:translateY(-2px)}
    .identity b{font:600 9px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:var(--accent-2);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .contact-actions{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-width:230px}
    .contact-actions .btn{width:100%}

    footer{padding:18px 24px 28px;background:var(--bg-soft);text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
    footer span{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#af7750;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}

    .toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(18px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(10,13,11,.92);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.24);transition:.3s ease;z-index:300;font-size:13px}
    .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

    body.neon-mode header,
    body.neon-mode .hero-card,
    body.neon-mode .game-card.valorant-main,
    body.neon-mode .contact-shell,
    body.neon-mode .live-card{
      box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(122,112,255,.16),0 0 30px rgba(88,74,255,.18),0 0 80px rgba(0,170,255,.14);
    }
    body.neon-mode nav,
    body.neon-mode .panel{border-color:rgba(122,112,255,.28)}


    .nav-icon{min-width:42px;font-size:18px;line-height:1}
    .nav-cta.live{background:#f05a5a;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(240,90,90,.18), 0 0 24px rgba(240,90,90,.25)}
    .hero-mobile-strip{display:none;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
    .hero-mobile-shot{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:120px;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:#131917}
    .hero-mobile-shot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
    .hero-mobile-shot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,10,9,.05),rgba(7,10,9,.76))}
